name: explainflow
description: Turn any topic into structured visual explanations using mind maps, flowcharts, diagrams, infographics, cheat sheets, workflows, timelines, comparisons, and more.

interface.shortDescription: Turn topics into clear visual and structured explanations
interface.longDescription: ExplainFlow converts topics into reusable visual and structured formats such as mind maps, flowcharts, diagrams, architecture views, infographics, cheat sheets, timelines, roadmaps, comparisons, flashcards, quizzes, and step-by-step explanations.
defaultPrompt: Create a mind map for this topic.
Turn this process into a flowchart.
Make a compact cheat sheet for this topic.
